system.description: You intuitively understand how to use an unfamiliar object, vehicle, or device, no matter how alien, advanced, or bizarre. You may make a COG Check to determine how to activate or use it, simply by looking at and handling it. This sleight does not provide any understanding of the principles or technologies involved — you simply grasp how to make it work. This sleight is only effective with unfamiliar devices, it provides no bonus when using devices with which you are familiar.

effectsToSelf.description: May use COG Check to understand how to use unfamiliar object/device.
